items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I used him on several of my recording dates.

ctx.x: Did he play a lot around 52nd Street?
Oh yeah, he was there on 52nd Street with different groups, very good. I used him on several of my recording dates. Teddy Walters.

Let's see what Chilton says happened to him. He's not even listed, that's funny. Also there was a tenor player named John Hardy that you did some records with in '47. Do you remember much about those?
